I AM SO LUCKY TO HAVE THE MOST INCREDIBLE CO-FOUNDERS @camtrew & Jake WHO MAKE THE IMPOSSIBLE POSSIBLE EVERY DAY.

Truly have never been happier, we’ve had the best few months for kleo - the team has never felt better and the product has never been better (and it will continue to get better). 

WHAT A TIME TO BE ALIVE.

Massive thank you to @kamya.marwah at @incmagazine for this incredible write up and featuring us. The best ever thank you! 

Agghhhhhhh ❤️🙏🏾

Mum, dad… we made it to Forbes 30U30! 

Been dreaming about this moment since I started my first business. 

Haven’t stopped thinking about it since. Journaled about it for years. 

The moment I saw a glimmer in my dad’s eyes when I told him this could be a possibility was the moment I decided I wouldn’t stop trying to become the person who made it on this list.

I told myself that I had to at least try and make it. For him, for me, for what it means to every girl that never had a role model that looked like them. 

And well, my friends. We made it. 

Let this be your proof that anything is possible.

No matter how many times I lost. I never quit. 

LinkedIn changed my life. Personal branding changed my life. Writing online changed my life.

Building a business (and failing) in public changed my life. 

And doing it all while in my 20s.

Don’t let anyone tell you you can’t do it.

Because you can. This is proof that you literally can change your entire life the moment you decide you want to. 

If the plan doesn’t work don’t change the goal, change the plan. 

What a privilege to get to see this happen. 

But what an even bigger privilege to get to share this win with every person that believed in me. 

Thank you, off to cry a bit more now.
This has been on my vision board since I was 18 🥹 THANK YOU ❤️

If Lara wants to sell Kleo for $20M, founder-led sales can’t be the long-term plan.

A buyer doesn’t want to acquire a business where revenue depends on the founder constantly showing up to close deals.

Look at companies like Loom and Trello. Virality helped them grow, but dedicated sales teams still drove a huge part of their revenue.

So I told Lara to start building that machine now.

She’s already hired her first Founding Account Executive and is building exactly what a future buyer would want to see.

The goal isn’t just to build a business that grows.

It’s to build one that can grow without you.
